# DrawTech Media

> DrawTech Media is a drone services business in Pennsylvania's Cumberland Valley, owned and operated by AJ Drawbaugh, an FAA Part 107 certified remote pilot (small UAS certificate earned July 2025). The business has operated since early 2024 and provides aerial photography, 3D mapping, roof inspections, construction progress updates and event coverage for real estate, construction and local businesses. Every project is flown and edited by AJ personally.

## Services

- [Real estate photography](https://drawtechmedia.com/services.html#real-estate): aerial photos and video of properties, lots and neighborhoods for listings
- [3D mapping](https://drawtechmedia.com/services.html#mapping): maps and 3D models of sites and buildings from aerial imagery
- [Roof inspections](https://drawtechmedia.com/services.html#roof): close-up aerial roof imagery without a ladder
- [Construction progress updates](https://drawtechmedia.com/services.html#construction): repeat aerial views of job sites
- [Aerial business media](https://drawtechmedia.com/services.html#business): aerial video and photos of businesses for websites, ads and social media
- [Event coverage](https://drawtechmedia.com/services.html#events): aerial photos and video of events and venues

## Key facts

- Owner and pilot: AJ Drawbaugh
- Credential: FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate (sUAS), July 2025
- In business since: early 2024
- Service area: Cumberland Valley, Pennsylvania (other locations by request)
- Pricing: quoted per project
- Slogan: "We'll handle the cooking."
